items.title: Swipe Through Galleries
items.subtitle: Swipe through every image right from the feed, with smarter sizing and seamless fullscreen transitions.

items.title: Comments Over Media
items.subtitle: Swipe up in the media viewer to read and reply while the photo or video stays on screen.

items.title: Better Multireddits
items.subtitle: Browse multireddits in Gallery View, then rename them and add descriptions or custom icons.

items.title: Posting & Media Fixes
items.subtitle: New comments appear correctly right away, while videos, previews, uploads, saves, and shares work more reliably.

items.title: Smoother, More Stable Apollo
items.subtitle: Major memory and crash fixes make Apollo more reliable, with smoother headers, profiles, themes, navigation, and iOS 27 layouts.
